notes: FleetComm 1.4.12 — the slow, stretched voice that came back after a restart has a cause and a fix. After 30 seconds without audio Chromium used to park the output on a timer, and Windows slows that timer for a window sitting behind a game, so the engine ran at 64% of real time until the output was re-opened. FleetComm now keeps the output awake so it is never parked, and no longer resets queued audio on a heal (the doubled-over sound). The SYSTEM LOG carries an audio diag line if it ever recurs. Also: the relay sync waits for late answers instead of slowing itself down, and standing changes land on the relay in seconds.
